title: B6-ITEM-5-STYLE FULL READ OF LIU arXiv 2610.26835 ('Zero-free half-planes for Hecke L-functions over number fields', 11,410-line source): NO FLAWS FOUND at audit level in the examined load-bearing pieces; the B_flat quartic INDEPENDENTLY RE-DERIVED from first principles (resultant of the paper's own cr/ell* formulas has the claimed kappa-quartic as its only nontrivial quartic factor; kappa = 2B-1 substitution gives exactly 2x the claimed B-quartic; root = 0.8748866470399641... = the 0143 cycle25-quartic B_flat); main theorem RE s > B_flat for EVERY number field K and finite-order Hecke character (transfer to F = K(zeta_12) + descent); scope is a number-field-uniform result STRONGLY WEAKER than [Z78G] on the zeta face - not adoptable in-tree, but the definitive design document for the next comparison system, and its reference stack (Liu26a = 2610.12234 = in-tree [Z78L] provenance cross-check PASS, Ope26b, XS26 v2, CT26 v2 + CTLean pin, Newton26) is fully pinned
body: Completed the B6-item-5-style full read of the next-system design document: B. Liu, 'Zero-free half-planes for Hecke L-functions over number fields', arXiv 2610.26835 (v1, uploaded 2026-10-20; 11,410-line single TeX source; eprint sha256 = 03ee309f932350245dc152dbc1f104e4346063d557030c695cb928299e021beb; workspace tmp/b6audit/liu26835/, VERDICT.md = the per-part audit record). MAIN THEOREM (Theorem vi:thm:main): for every number field K and every finite-order Hecke character chi of K, L_K(s,chi) != 0 for Re s > B_flat = 0.8748866470399641... (root in (0.874,0.875) of 133488B^4 - 376596B^3 + 384534B^2 - 167541B + 26231); in particular zeta_K zero-free there (s != 1); consequences: monomial Artin L-functions, and zeta_L/zeta_K zero-free INCLUDING at s=1. STRUCTURE: (1) Part I recalls, with locators and without proofs, the foundation from [Ope26a] (QRH 7/8 over Q(sqrt-3), cubic theta) and [Liu26a] = arXiv 2610.12234 v2: B_new = (18 xi + 7)/(18 xi + 9) with 1188 xi^3 - 2160 xi^2 + 171 xi + 190, B_new = 0.874957019420098946... = B_infty, the one-step bootstrap beta <= (1+kappa)/2 => beta <= B(xi), the fixed point kappa_new = 2 B_new - 1, and the pointwise-system optimality inf = B_new (dual-bound machinery, Theorem 34.4 recall + cyclotomic transfer, Theorem v:thm:optimality). (2) Part II gives the full analytic derivation over cyclotomic F superset mu_12: the Kazhdan-Patterson exceptional theta representation (radial functional equation over F), GL/BGL sieve transplants to arbitrary number fields, inverse moments (M1) and the unweighted product moment (M2, 13/18 <= kappa <= 1, zero-free hypothesis beta_*(F) <= (1+kappa)/2 retained per application and discharged inside the proof), the compensated comparison reaching B_infty, then the REFINED system: the amplified first moment of the reflected numerator (Prop v:prop:refined-numerator, read in full - AFE over F + Holder + M2 four moment with prime amplification from the class factors, conductor deficit by a single simultaneous bound; faithful adaptation of [XS26], whose conclusion is NOT used as input), the critical class (delta_c(kappa), 1/2) with cr(d,kappa) = (3-324k^2)d^2 + (756k^2-54k-5)d + 40k - 300k^2, the tangent family (b*, ell*, kappa) (interval arithmetic on 4000 exact-rational subintervals; certified script family_certificate.py), and the ONE-STEP limiting contradiction (assume beta > B_flat; beta <= B_infty; kappa = 2 beta - 1 (M2 with equality); F_flat(kappa) < beta; ell < ell*(kappa) close: beta <= B(ell) < beta - no iteration, hence no uniformity needed). (3) Part III removes the cyclotomic restriction: transfer theorem itemizing EVERY input used over arbitrary F superset mu_12 (mu_12 lemma, KP over arbitrary fields containing mu_3, GL/BGL, class number one of Z[omega], Chebotarev/Grunwald-Wang; no uniformity in F, constants depend on F,S,target), and descent through F = K(zeta_12): Gal(M_eta F/F) embeds in the cyclic Gal(M_eta/K) => E/F abelian for EVERY K; the three factorizations zeta_E = prod L_F, zeta_E = zeta_M prod(entire), zeta_M = prod_j L_K(chi^j), with the zeta-residue identity at s=1 (Milne CFT). The cyclotomic-only descent class is equivalently characterized by metabelian normal closure of M_eta (both directions, standard). INDEPENDENT EXACT-ARITHMETIC AUDIT (this discovery, sympy exact + interval checks): (a) the resultant in delta of (ell*(delta,kappa) - (8/3 - 2 kappa)) against cr(delta,kappa), computed fresh from the paper's displayed formulas, factors as (15k-2)(42k+5) k^2 (6k-1)^2 (16686k^4 - 27405k^3 + 9936k^2 + 1290k - 275): the claimed kappa-quartic is EXACTLY the only nontrivial quartic factor of the true elimination; (b) substituting kappa = 2B - 1 gives precisely 2 x (133488B^4 - 376596B^3 + 384534B^2 - 167541B + 26231): the claimed B-quartic is exact; (c) the kappa bracket (0.749773294079928, 0.749773294079929) is sign-verified (qk low > 0, qk high < 0) and B_flat = (1+kappa)/2 = 0.8748866470399641...; the four B-quartic roots (0.4092630642, 0.5640155928, 0.8748866470399641, 0.9730321070) match the 0143 cycle25-quartic B_flat exactly, and the board's cycle25-quartic record = 683505193/781250000 = B_flat + 3.587e-11 (the paper's rational chain B_sharp = 874886647041/10^12 = B_flat + 1.04e-12 is sharper). Optimality: B_flat is the EXACT infimum of the refined comparison system (chains from above never attain it; chains from 7/8 approach within any epsilon via Delta_{j+1} < 0.0033 Delta_j + 2 eps_j); the rational chain appendix displays full exact polynomial identity certificates for all four stages, with the first two REPRODUCING Xu-Sang's B1 = 8748867/10^7 over F (scripts pinned with SHA-256; scalar certificates only, not Lean verification of the analytic estimates). PROVENANCE: the reference stack is fully pinned and mutually consistent - [Liu26a] arXiv 2610.12234 v2 (2026-10-12) = EXACTLY the in-tree [Z78L] citation and cubic (Z78Liu.lean line 15/23): cross-check PASS; [Ope26b] = OpenAI 'Primitive roots for every admissible integer base' (Oct 4 2026, openai/math dated manuscript) - local/global theta SOURCE input, its zero-free conclusion explicitly NOT used (no circularity); [XS26] v2 (revised 2026-10-15); [CT26] v2 (Axiom Math hexagon:2610.00200) + [CTLean] pinned revision 09afbb4ce6570c1615d58509dc197fc9f0956b7d - the seven descendant continuation/descent/residue/Euler-product lemmas are adapted from that external Lean formalization (stated by the paper; the paper's own Lean is 'in progress' covering scalar + selected arithmetic implications only); [Newton26] Zenodo 23414581 (B_N = 0.87488664962 rational certificate; fixed-range barrier B_lim = 0.87488664961663, a different admissible kappa-range that the tangent family legitimately crosses: kappa_flat = 0.749773294079928... < 29991/40000). SCOPES (all explicit, honest): scalar statements about the specified systems only; class-by-class mixing / unequal lengths / stronger analytic inputs are NOT covered; no assertion on Re s = B_flat. PROGRAM CONSEQUENCES: (1) NOT adoptable in-tree as a zeta-face competitor: B_flat = 0.87488664... > [Z78G] = 0.8748087 (weaker); it is a scope result over every number field; no in-tree change, no RH claim. (2) It is the definitive DESIGN DOCUMENT for the next comparison system: the refined-system template (averaged numerator, critical-class tangent contact, kappa = 2 beta - 1 feedback with equality at the limit, exact infimum with a published optimality theorem, and the explicit list of what a next system must supply) is exactly the structure our 0144 analysis detected inside the adopted Gao five-step family (net sensitivity 8.74, corner-contact at the binding row) - two independent systems, one template. (3) With 0141+0144, the ecosystem-wide picture is now complete at this level: every comparison family being squeezed to its exact infimum; the forward path is a stronger analytic input (new mean-value estimate, sharper count, Gram/reflected-energy, amplified length) or a new structural cycle - the tail-endpoint's 0.8748087 vs the quartic system's 0.87488664 are two different families' ceilings, and the in-tree program's decision space (adopt the next tracker record via the B6 section-8 conveyor; or attack the residual face hOffG in-tree) is unchanged by this read. NO RH CLAIM.
